data.name: MTQL (Mark-to-Query Language) is a domain-specific language for filtering questions by their tags. You write expressions like "(difficulty:hard && source:textbook) || knowledge_point:calculus" to precisely select which questions appear in a paper. It supports AND, OR, NOT, and parenthesized grouping.
data.value: MTQL (Mark-to-Query Language) on domain-erityinen kieli kysymysten suodattamiseen niiden tunnisteiden perusteella. Kirjoitat lausekkeita kuten "(difficulty:hard && source:textbook) || knowledge_point:calculus" valitaksesi tarkasti, mitkä kysymykset näkyvät kokeessa. Se tukee AND-, OR- ja NOT-operaattoreita sekä sulkujen muodostamaa ryhmittelyä.
